newsitem.title: USA: Molex capital spending to fall in FY97.
newsitem.headline: Molex capital spending to fall in FY97.

text.p: Molex Inc said Tuesday it will spend about three percent less on capital expenditures in fiscal 1997 compared to fiscal 1996, but more on research and development.

Molex, which earlier reported net income of $40.2 million and revenues of $377.0 million in the second quarter ended December 31, said it plans to invest $215.0 million in capital expenditures for the full year ending June 30. That compares to $222.4 million spent in fiscal 1996.
Molex said it plans to spend $90 million for research and development this year, compared to $85.5 million last year.
Molex make electronic and electrical interconnection products. Its shares closed down 3/8 Tuesday at 37-7/8.
